messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Online shinyStan demo taken down by RStudio
parts: The good news is that the shinyStan online demo is very popular. The bad news is that it went over the usage limits set by RStudio and now they've disabled it. Maybe if someone else wants to put it on their shinyapps.io account then we could host it there. Since I don't have paid membership it won't be back online on my account until next month unfortunately. Or until we work something out with the RStudio folks maybe.
